title: Class Odyssey — Petit aventurier lumineux
userReference: User-supplied image of a compact, blond, green-clad elf adventurer in the style of Zelda: Link's Awakening. The saved imgres.html is a Google Images page, not an imported character asset.
revisionRequest: c'est bien mais il est un peu bizare et court sur patte tu arrive à le fair un peu plus classe stp
method: Original meshes, rounded primitives and elliptical swept surfaces authored directly in Blender 4.5.3 via Blender MCP. No image-to-3D service, downloaded character or bitmap texture is used.
design: Rounded-square face, simple black oval eyes, broad golden hair locks, folded green cap, green tunic, pale leggings, chestnut boots, blue enamel shield with original compass badge, short fantasy blade.
refinements: Legs lengthened by 0.18 Blender units, head reduced to 89%, ear reach reduced to 76%, boot width reduced to 88% and depth to 90%. Boot volumes voxel-fused; leggings taper inside cuffs. Face and leather changed to satin materials. Body equipment moves rigidly with the torso.

scene.materials: Named, self-contained PBR colors with no external image dependencies.

portrait.origin: Actual Cycles render of the exported character, 64 samples, three large area lights, transparent film, AgX Medium High Contrast, exposure 0.15.

web: A separate daylight studio with a static Blender portrait and an on-demand WebGL model. The lighting in the browser is intentionally a separate real-time studio.
